title: Row-level provenance
problem_this_solves: Reviewers cannot tell verified data from guessed data
proposal: Keep the source_id + accessed_utc columns on every data table and render them as a linked column in the site (implemented in scripts/build_site.py)
expected_impact: Removes the whole class of 'is this real?' questions; makes each row auditable in one click

title: Verification badges on every row
problem_this_solves: Unverified values look identical to verified ones
proposal: Add a status badge per row (verified / derived / unverified-blank) and a per-page verification meter at the top
expected_impact: A decision-maker sees at a glance how much of a page can be trusted

title: Client-side table filtering
problem_this_solves: Filtering a 160-row injury table by hand is slow and error-prone
proposal: Add client-side search + column filters to every generated table (no backend)
expected_impact: Faster review of the availability board

title: Side-by-side market comparison
problem_this_solves: No way to compare our number to the market number side by side
proposal: Keep the Lines page layout: model spread | market spread | diff | timestamp, with the market column blank until Q-01 is answered
expected_impact: This is the single screen the whole project is judged on

title: Decision control per suggestion
problem_this_solves: Suggestions are read but not decided
proposal: Add an approve / reject / defer control that writes into data/suggestions.csv owner_decision via a PR from the owner's fork
expected_impact: Converts the register into an actual decision log without any external tooling
risk: needs a write path (GitHub issue form or PR)

title: A single flagged-for-review queue
problem_this_solves: Flagged items live in a CSV nobody re-reads
proposal: Keep the Flagged for Review page as the one queue, with severity + one-click source link + resolved state
expected_impact: Prevents silent data rot

title: Model health page
problem_this_solves: No historical view of how the model has been doing
proposal: Add a Model Health page: per-week residual SD of margin and total, plus calibration plot data
expected_impact: Shows when the model drifts, which is the only way to know whether an edge is real

title: Merge four availability feeds
problem_this_solves: Weekly report only: IR players vanish from it (F-12/Q-03, the Baltimore example)
proposal: Merge report + transactions/IR + inactive lists + club PR wires into one availability table, keeping a per-source timestamp
expected_impact: Turns 'who is out' from a guess into a ledger; the largest single quality jump available

title: Affiliation audit
problem_this_solves: Player-team affiliation is not independently confirmed in the injury data
proposal: For every availability row, confirm the player is on that club's roster from an official club page; auto-flag mismatches
expected_impact: Catches wire errors before they reach a model (see FLG-012); 8 candidate mismatches are already queued

title: Labelled stat columns
problem_this_solves: Team-stat pages publish numbers without machine-readable column headers
proposal: Scrape with the label row (or use a licensed partner API) and store label+value pairs; never publish a column whose label is absent
expected_impact: Removes the ambiguity that forced 11 of 39 stat columns to be withheld (FLG-014)

title: Game-level history
problem_this_solves: No game-level history in the repo: 33 of 137 verified 2026 games, and no prior season
proposal: Ingest 5+ seasons of per-game results, and lines once licensed, into data/history/
expected_impact: Unlocks Q-04, Q-05, Q-06, Q-07 - i.e. every calibration constant in the model

title: Two independent ratings
problem_this_solves: Rating method is untested and single-model
proposal: Ship (a) opponent-adjusted least-squares ratings and (b) possession-based efficiency ratings; publish both and their disagreement
expected_impact: Disagreement between two defensible models is a better uncertainty measure than either model's confidence

title: Price totals from pace x efficiency
problem_this_solves: Totals are priced off points per game only
proposal: Build totals from verified dropbacks (pass att + sacks) and rush attempts, converted to per-play rates and multiplied by projected plays
expected_impact: Volume-based totals are less exposed to garbage time than scoring averages

title: Leaderboard as the allocator
problem_this_solves: One model, no competition
proposal: Run the leaderboard as the allocation mechanism: each week's bankroll share is proportional to gate-adjusted skill (fractional Kelly of the measured edge)
expected_impact: Forces weak strategies to die in data instead of in the bankroll
risk: needs market data and a mandate

title: Grade prediction quality first
problem_this_solves: Signals get judged on results
proposal: Split evaluation into prediction quality (log-loss / Brier on the win probability implied by the line) and betting results (ROI, CLV); prediction quality must pass first
expected_impact: This is how luck is removed: a good bet can lose, a bad bet can win; only prediction quality converges quickly

title: Sealed walk-forward
problem_this_solves: Backtests are silently overfitted
proposal: Enforce walk-forward with a sealed parameter freeze (config hash committed before kickoff) and a holdout season no code path may read
expected_impact: Removes the single most common way a fake edge is manufactured

title: Multiple-comparison control
problem_this_solves: Multiple-testing abuse: 500 signals, one goes green
proposal: Benjamini-Hochberg across the whole signal catalogue each quarter, plus Deflated Sharpe on the leaderboard's top rows
expected_impact: Turns 'we found an edge' into a statement with a number attached

title: Regenerate everything from data
problem_this_solves: Nothing is repeatable if a human typed it
proposal: Regenerate every published number from data/ through scripts (build + verify + link-check) in one command; publish the verification report on the site
expected_impact: Any reviewer can reproduce the whole site from raw sources

title: Stake ladder and stand-downs
problem_this_solves: No stake discipline
proposal: Fixed unit ladder with per-strategy caps, a per-slate exposure cap, and an automatic stand-down after two consecutive gate breaches
expected_impact: Keeps variance from ending the project before the sample gets big enough

title: Timestamped bet ledger
problem_this_solves: Bet record is informal
proposal: Write every bet to a ledger: strategy id, model price, market price at bet time, closing price, stake, result, settlement source link
expected_impact: Without the timestamped record, CLV cannot be computed and the leaderboard cannot be audited

title: Correlation-aware parlay pricing
problem_this_solves: Correlation is assumed away in parlays
proposal: Price parlays from a simulated joint distribution rather than multiplying legs; publish implied-vs-offered parlay price
expected_impact: Books make their margin on parlays exactly here; this is where extra value is found or avoided
risk: needs correlation data and a game simulation

title: Generated changelog
problem_this_solves: No way to know what changed since the last review
proposal: Add a changelog page generated from git log for data/ and models/, showing what moved since each review
expected_impact: Review time drops sharply when only the delta is presented

title: Weather and roof type
problem_this_solves: Weather is never used, though it is a documented input to totals
proposal: Attach an NWS forecast + venue roof type to every game row before kickoff
expected_impact: Needed for any Nov-Dec total model; also feeds the S-21 correlation work
risk: needs a read path for SRC-015

title: Rewards paid on calibration
problem_this_solves: Rewards on the leaderboard can be gamed
proposal: Reward = prediction quality (log-loss vs market) x sample weight, not ROI; publish the formula; freeze the methodology hash for the season; independent recompute from the bet ledger
expected_impact: If the prize is paid on ROI the rational play is high-variance gambling; if it is paid on calibration the rational play is exactly what we want

title: An explicit abstain rule
problem_this_solves: No notion of when to abstain
proposal: Add a confidence gate: bet only when the model-vs-market gap exceeds (vig + measured model error band); the default action is pass
expected_impact: Selectivity is the whole game at -110: a 52.4% hit rate is break-even, so the pass rule is what turns a model into an edge
risk: needs the error band from Q-05
